Re-gasket with new SW SS316 gasket and box up to torque (Record in equipment history)

text: Thermal-Shock Avoidance on Start-Up. This One Point Lesson explains thermal-shock avoidance on start-up for EA-5601 (SOLVENT HEATER) in the SOLVENT HEATING SYSTEM. Warm the exchanger through gradually (Interlock status confirmed) 4. Avoid sudden large steps in the outlet temperature set-point (Change logged on DCS) 5. Watch for knocking that indicates condensate hammer (Handover to next shift)

text: Tube Leak Detection & Plugging. This One Point Lesson explains tube leak detection & plugging for EA-5601 (SOLVENT HEATER) in the SOLVENT HEATING SYSTEM. Plug both ends of the tube with tapered plugs (Torque / clearance to spec) 4. Record the plugged-tube count (maximum 5 % of tubes) (No leak / smooth operation) 5. Plan bundle replacement if the plugging limit is reached (Record in equipment history)
